prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound through the intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a southbound sedan operated by Driver 2. The impact occurred in the middle of the intersection. Responding officers observed that the point of contact and the resulting deformation were consistent with a broadside collision at the speeds reported by both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the crash happened as Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses at the corner gave statements that matched this account. Photographs taken at the scene show the damage to the vehicles and the roadway debris pattern consistent with the reported sequence. A passenger seated in the front right position was also present in Driver 1's vehicle and was identified by both drivers and the witnesses. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for evaluation. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy associated with the vehicle involved.
